about.title: About the stadium
about.paragraph1: Dynamo City Stadium has been the club's home ground since its founding in 1985. Situated in the heart of the Dynamic district, the stadium underwent a major renovation in 2010 — modern stands, upgraded facilities and a resurfaced pitch now offer the best possible experience for 45,000 supporters.
about.paragraph2: The atmosphere at a Dynamo City home match is like no other. The roar of the stands, the club's gold-and-navy colours and the feeling of belonging to something greater — that is what makes every match an unforgettable occasion.
